title: scopebond:observation envelope v1
description: A closed, separately versioned envelope for lifecycle, health, policy-acknowledgement and independently sourced outcome observations. It is NOT a receipt: signed receipts, their canonicalization and their signature semantics are unchanged. The signature covers the UTF-8 bytes of the domain 'scopebond:observation/v1' plus one LF byte, followed by the RFC 8785 canonical payload. A stored observation is evidence of its source's assertion, not proof of the asserted external effect. Tenant, environment and agent identity are derived by the receiving service from the credential and installation binding and are never payload claims. The schema describes shape and closedness; a verifier additionally enforces the cross-field rules stated in the package README.
